article.en: We have an old musical instrument and it is called a clavichord.
article.zh: 我家有件古乐器，它叫古钢琴。

article.en: It was made in Germany in 1681.
Our clavichord is kept in the living-room.
article.zh: 我们的这架古钢琴存放在起居室里。

article.en: It has belonged to our family for a long time.
article.zh: 我们家有这件乐器已经很久了。

article.en: The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.
article.zh: 它是我祖父在很多年以前买的。

article.en: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
article.zh: 可它最近被一个客人弄坏了。

article.en: She tried to play jazz on it!
article.zh: 因为她竟用它来弹奏爵士乐！

article.en: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.
article.zh: 她在击琴键时用力过猛，损坏了两根琴弦。

article.en: My father was shocked and now we are not allowed to touch it.
article.zh: 我父亲大为吃惊，不许我们再动它。

article.en: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
article.zh: 父亲的一个朋友正在修理这件乐器。
